items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But he was a great athlete and a fantastic swimmer, and he taught me how to swim.

ctx.x: No I wasn’t. Especially because I had never been around kids that young. All the people I knew were older. So that was a little different AB So did you have friends in school as well as in the neighborhood?

Well we had friends in school, and in the neighborhood this guy Mathis, his father had about 18 children, and one boy, and he was the only boy. So he had all these girls! (Laughs) But he was a great athlete and a fantastic swimmer, and he taught me how to swim.
Were there other athletics you were involved with?
